subtitle: Overwrite in place, no history kept

code:
MERGE INTO analytics.dim_customer AS tgt
USING staging.customers_cleaned AS src
    ON tgt.customer_id = src.customer_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
    tgt.customer_name = src.customer_name,
    tgt.region = src.region
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
    (customer_key, customer_id, customer_name, region)
    VALUES (HASH(src.customer_id), src.customer_id,
            src.customer_name, src.region);
caption: Same MERGE you know from T-SQL — matched rows overwritten, new rows inserted with a HASH key.
